stories.text: If it's not perfect, don't even start. / A messy start beats a perfect plan.
What are you avoiding today because it feels too big?
Open it. Work 2 minutes. Then decide.
Replay that awkward moment one more time. / Nobody else is still thinking about it.
Tired thoughts aren't true thoughts. Let them wait for morning.
You don't have to solve your life before you fall asleep.
Who are you still trying to keep happy at your own cost?
Before you say yes, pause for one breath.
Someone being disappointed doesn't mean you did wrong.
Everyone else has it figured out. / You're seeing their best minute, not their whole day.
Someone else moving fast doesn't make you late.
When you compare, ask: what do I actually want?
You haven't earned a break yet. / Rest is part of the work, not a reward.
A slow Sunday is not a wasted one.
Lie down. No phone. Ten quiet minutes.
Which choice are you still waiting to feel sure about?
Pick wrong and you'll regret it. / Most choices are doors, not walls.
Pick one. Give it a week. Then review.
